tasks.title: Setup Expo project with SQLite and AsyncStorage
tasks.description: Initialize Expo project with required dependencies for offline-first data persistence including expo-sqlite, @react-native-async-storage/async-storage, and project structure
acceptanceCriteria: Expo project initialized with TypeScript template
expo-sqlite installed and configured
AsyncStorage installed and configured
Database schema defined for sessions, streaks, and garden state
Basic project folder structure created (src/components, src/hooks, src/utils, src/database)

tasks.title: Implement database models and CRUD operations
tasks.description: Create data models and database operations for sessions, streaks, garden state, and user settings
acceptanceCriteria: Session model with create, read, update, delete operations
Streak model with current streak, longest streak tracking
Garden state model for plant growth and health
User settings model for preferences
All operations work offline without network

tasks.title: Create timer hook with background tracking
tasks.description: Implement useTimer hook that tracks session duration accurately even when app is backgrounded
acceptanceCriteria: Timer starts from 00:00 and counts up
Timer continues when app is backgrounded using expo-background-task
Timer state persists across app restarts
Session recovery dialog shown if app was force-quit during session
Maximum 4-hour auto-end functionality

tasks.title: Build Timer Screen UI
tasks.description: Create the timer screen with large digital display, garden mini-view, and session controls
acceptanceCriteria: Large digital timer display (MM:SS format)
Mini garden view showing current state
End Session button with secondary styling
Focus mode toggle button
Session note quick-add (expandable)
Under 5-minute warning modal

tasks.title: Implement notification system
tasks.description: Setup expo-notifications for daily reminders with customizable time
acceptanceCriteria: Notification permission request with context
Daily notification scheduling at user-selected time (default 7 PM)
Notification copy: 'Time to study! Keep your streak alive 🌱'
Settings to change reminder time
Graceful handling of permission denial

tasks.title: Create garden visualization component
tasks.description: Build the garden display with growth stages, wilting states, and animations
acceptanceCriteria: Garden component with multiple plant support
Growth stages: sprout, growing, mature, blooming
Wilting visual states for missed days
Healthy garden ambient animation (subtle swaying)
Freeze state with ice crystal overlay

tasks.title: Implement session completion celebration

acceptanceCriteria: 2-3 second celebration animation on session complete
Garden growth visible (new leaf, flower blooming)

acceptanceCriteria: Streak increments when 5+ min session completed in a day
Streak resets to 0 if no session by 4 AM next day
Grace period banner between midnight-4 AM with countdown
Wilting garden visual during grace period
Proper handling of timezone and daylight saving

tasks.title: Build streak freeze mechanic
tasks.description: Implement weekly streak freeze allocation and usage UI
acceptanceCriteria: One freeze allocated every Monday at midnight
Freeze availability indicator on Home Screen
Prominent CTA during grace period to use freeze
Ice crystal overlay on streak badge when frozen
Proper error message if trying to use freeze after streak breaks

tasks.title: Create history and statistics screen
tasks.description: Build history screen with 30-day calendar heatmap and stats dashboard
acceptanceCriteria: Stats dashboard: current streak, longest streak, total hours, avg session
30-day calendar heatmap with color intensity by duration
Session list with date, time, duration, tags
Tap day to see session details
Empty state with encouraging message for new users

tasks.title: Build onboarding flow

Garden introduction with animated explanation
Notification permission request with context
Reminder time picker (default 7 PM)
First garden view with single sprout

History secondary button
Settings icon in header

tasks.title: Implement focus mode

Full-screen mode with no status bar when enabled
expo-keep-awake prevents screen sleep
